book: Thomas Morton, Antidotum adversus Ecclesiae Romanae de merito proprie dicto (Cambridge, 1637): one controversial treatise in twenty numbered chapters, each divided into sections, preceded by dedicatory and prefatory matter and followed by an index of matters and an index of Scripture.
